narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The set one, five and five has a tiny side, so it is not a triangle.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Draw it and see: the two arcs of five centimetres cross high above the short base.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A short side still makes a tall, thin triangle.

<bookmark mark='m2'/>Count how many sides match, and then name the kind.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Build a triangle with sides of seven, seven and four centimetres, and name its kind.
